themes.label: Hidden minimum wallet balance blocks chat
themes.summary: Users report that after recharging, they are blocked from chatting even though they still hold a positive balance (often ₹60 to ₹70), because the app enforces a higher minimum balance (₹75 or more) before a chat can start. Many also say the per-minute rate jumps from a promoted ₹1 or ₹15 to much higher amounts mid-session, and that the minimum balance rule was never shown before payment. Nearly all of these reviews are on Android and most cite recent app versions (v29 to v32), with users asking for refunds of the unusable remainder.
themes.recommendation: Audit the chat-start balance check and the pre-payment pricing disclosure on Android: compare the minimum-balance threshold shown at recharge against the enforced threshold, log cases where a session is blocked with balance above the displayed per-minute rate, and ship a fix that either lets users spend their existing balance or clearly displays the minimum before purchase, then review refund eligibility for affected wallets.

themes.label: Paid predictions seen as fake
themes.summary: Reviews are split between praise for a simple, fun, and accurate app (mostly older iOS versions) and harsh complaints from recent Android builds (v30 to v32) that predictions are wrong and that the app pushes users to pay more for consultations. Several reviewers say the answers feel AI-generated or generic, and others report glitches, missing chat history, rude customer care, and fewer features than the Android version.
themes.recommendation: Pull session and payment logs for Android v31 and v32 users who report missing chat history or upsell prompts, then review whether paid-consultation prompts and AI-generated answers are clearly labeled and disclosed before purchase.

themes.label: AI astrology results unreliable and disappointing
themes.summary: Many reviewers in this cluster praise the app's free information and experienced human astrologers, but a recurring complaint is that the newer AI astrology feature gives long, vague, or inaccurate answers, with some saying their chart changed after the AI update. Several users also feel the app pushes paid chats and recharges, with astrologers stalling sessions and some suspecting fake astrologers on the platform.
themes.recommendation: Audit the AI astrology output against a set of reference Kundli charts to compare with the pre-AI calculation engine, and add a toggle or fallback so users can view the classic chart while the AI feature is reviewed.

themes.label: Post-update crashes, back button, data loss
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS say that recent app updates broke core functions, most often the back button inside a kundli, chart loading that hangs, old kundalis and chat history disappearing, and login or OTP failures. Several reviewers also report that reinstalling caused them to lose saved charts, and one reports pop-up ads locking the screen. Mixed in are complaints about subscription cancellation and region or phone-number login blocks, which look like separate issues.
themes.recommendation: Pull crash and error logs for the latest Android and iOS releases (v31.x on Android, v9.x on iOS), reproduce the back-button hang on a kundli screen and the chart-loading freeze, and confirm whether saved kundli and chat history are being wiped on app reinstall or update, then ship a hotfix with a rollback plan.

themes.label: Prediction accuracy and AI reliability
themes.summary: Reviewers split sharply on whether predictions are accurate, with recent Android reviews (v29.5 to v32.0) calling the AI-generated predictions and dates wrong, generic, or contradictory, and some saying paid consultations were not worth the money. Older reviews praise the kundli calculations and daily predictions, though a few note recycled daily content, a date off by one day for non-Indian users, and overly positive or negative framing of certain house and dasha readings.
themes.recommendation: Audit the AI prediction pipeline on recent Android builds (v29.5 to v32.0) by replaying a set of known past events and known chart dasha periods to verify date and mahadasha calculations, and add a visible disclaimer and refund path for paid consultations.

themes.label: Praise: accuracy and readings
themes.summary: Most reviews in this cluster are short praise for how accurate and detailed the readings feel, with several calling the Hindi-language content useful. Mixed in are complaints about the AI kundali giving inconsistent answers on recent Android versions (v31.x), slow or blocked live advisor sessions, and high consultation prices. Tamil-speaking users also say the Hindi-only content is hard to read.
themes.recommendation: Run a regression test that submits the same kundali inputs to the AI kundali feature repeatedly on Android v31.x and compares outputs, and separately audit the live-session chat flow for advisor blocking and response-time issues.

themes.label: Praise: easy navigation and interface
themes.summary: Users in this cluster are praising how easy the app is to navigate, with the interface described as helpful, convenient, and simple, including for beginners. The reviews are short, generic compliments with no complaints or feature requests, and they span app versions v31.2 to v31.9 on Android only.
themes.recommendation: Protect the current navigation and interface patterns in regression testing for future Android releases, and document them as the baseline for any redesign so the simplicity users value is not lost.

themes.label: Praise: easy chart navigation
themes.summary: Users in this cluster are praising how easy and smooth the birth charts are to read and navigate on Android, with many calling them good for beginners and convenient for daily use on mobile. The reviews are short and uniformly positive, with no complaints or feature requests in the sample.
themes.recommendation: Protect the chart navigation experience in upcoming releases by adding a regression check for chart rendering and navigation smoothness on Android versions 31.2 and 31.9 before each release.

themes.label: Praise: saved charts convenience
themes.summary: Users on Android are uniformly praising the ability to save charts in AstroSage Kundli, calling the feature convenient and useful. The reviews are short and repetitive, with no complaints, feature requests, or mentions of specific screens beyond saved charts and divisional charts.
themes.recommendation: Protect the saved charts flow in regression testing for each Android release, and consider exploring whether saved charts can be extended to divisional charts since users mention them alongside saving.

themes.label: Praise: planet details, plus degree request
themes.summary: Nearly all reviews in this cluster are short praise saying the planet details are useful, with one wrapper note saying the app is nice. The only actionable request is from a single user asking for planetary degrees to be shown on the Navamsha chart.
themes.recommendation: Check whether planetary degree values are already computed for the Navamsha (D9) chart and, if so, add them to the chart view, otherwise scope the calculation work as a ticket and protect the existing planet details feature in the meantime.
